title: GCP Cloud TPU VM variables
description: Configuration variables for GCP Cloud TPU VMs and Queued Resources

TPU_VM_VERSION.description: Specific version of tpu-vm to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

GCP_TPU_VM_VERSION.description: Version alias for the gcp-tpu-vm component.

GCP_TPU_VM_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy override for the gcp-tpu-vm component.

TPU_SCHEDULING_TYPE.description: Scheduling type for the TPU VM (on-demand, spot, or preemptible).

TPU_ACCELERATOR_TYPE.description: Type of TPU accelerator (e.g., v4-8, v4-32, v5litepod-8, v6e-8). Defines the hardware topology.

TPU_ZONE.description: GCP Zone for TPU provisioning. Must match an approved grant zone in tfrc.policy.json when TFRC is active.

TPU_VERSION.description: TPU VM OS runtime version ('auto' resolves v2/v3/v4 -> tpu-ubuntu2204-base, v5litepod/v5e -> v2-alpha-tpuv5-lite, v5p -> v2-alpha-tpuv5, v6e -> v2-alpha-tpuv6e).

TPU_COUNT.description: Number of independent TPU VMs or pod slices to provision.

TPU_USE_QUEUED_RESOURCE.description: Whether to use the GCP Queued Resources API for provisioning single-host and multi-host slices.

TPU_NO_QUEUED_RESOURCE.description: Flag (0 or 1) opting out of Queued Resources when direct tpu-vm creation is explicitly permitted.

TPU_DATA_DISK_SIZE.description: Size of the persistent data disk in GB (optional; stripped to empty in TFRC zero-cost mode).

TPU_DATA_DISK_TYPE.description: Type of the persistent data disk (e.g., pd-balanced).

TPU_NETWORK.description: Optional VPC network name for TPU VM provisioning.

TPU_SUBNETWORK.description: Optional VPC subnetwork name for TPU VM provisioning.

TPU_PROFILE_LOGDIR.description: Remote directory on TPU VM workers where capture_tpu_profile writes profile traces.

TPU_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: Maximum timeout in seconds for wait-ready polling of Queued Resources and multi-worker SSH.

TPU_WAIT_POLL_SEC.description: Polling interval in seconds for wait-ready status checks.

GCP_TPU_VM_ENABLED.description: Flag (0 or 1) indicating whether gcp-tpu-vm is enabled in the execution plan.
